title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative perfect-gas Navier–Stokes, case Reynolds viscosity and separate inviscid/viscous routines present.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS, geometry, boundary tagging and graph partition source exist; failed histories do not validate their accuracy.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp assembles face fluxes with global reductions; invalid laminar residuals and failed final cases limit validation.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov and Roe paths exist, but failed M0.8/M2 histories do not establish robust production behavior.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip routines exist; output.cpp sets reported no-slip wall u/v to zero.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Least-squares gradients and face reconstruction are called, but production smooth-order accuracy remains unverified.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth limiter and positivity fallback implemented; successful accuracy or limiter frequency not demonstrated.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian viscous path and approximate tangential wall shear exist; all laminar residual histories have nonfinite values.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Steady solver uses one frozen-RHS LU-SGS sweep; selected final response reports inability to achieve required convergence.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Frozen BDF2 history and inner target logic exist, but rank-summed counters can inflate per-step statistics and no Re200 final result exists.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Root partitions with METIS and neighbor exchange exists; only rank0 local fields are written and no credible np comparison.

disqualification_flags.evidence: See the explicit trigger-7 finding in the top-level disqualification assessment.
